title: Q-AUDIT-seed-autonomous: fm-seed-not-autonomous failing (fail): Read the blocking loops in the seed's /health ignition field. Give the generated seed its own repository and a token scoped to that repository only, bound by deploy/deploy-seed
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** the daily failure audit files it; the executor takes it in driver order
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe seed-autonomous
**Status:** open

Failure mode `fm-seed-not-autonomous` detected by `seed-autonomous`, failing since 2026-11-24T16:27:15Z.
Evidence:  deployed 135 h ago and at stage ticking, below looping: not ticking: executor (failing), issuesync (failing), repo-access (failing), deploy-evidence (failing), watchdog-gh (failing), live-changes (failing), redmain (failing), tenant-deploy (failing), repo-visibility (failing), kill-drill (stopped)

Signature: cee2a53570a7 (disposition: fix).
Suspected root cause: a seed was deployed with a database and a cron only: no source-control credential and no repository of its own, so every loop that reads or writes a repository fails and the seed stays at ticking
Remedy: Read the blocking loops in the seed's /health ignition field. Give the generated seed its own repository and a token scoped to that repository only, bound by deploy/deploy-seed.mjs, then let its loops record beats; never accept /health 200 as autonomy and never lower the stage (SEED-AUTONOMY-1).
Fix the earliest cause, so the detector passes; do not weaken or remove the detector.

**Closing probe:** cmd:python3 -m foundation failure_audit --probe seed-autonomous
